health: Every pedigree person has an explicit five-marker Health personal state.
Absence of an active HealthCondition row means no instantiated active durable condition at Turn 0; it does not mean unknown.
Ordinary care is household burden; only specialized landed-house demand rows require future Care Commitment construction.
Specialized-care demand rows do not identify or assign a caregiver.
traits: Every living and deceased person has all eight Trait tiers explicitly stored.
Historical Trait state is anchored at death.
capabilities: Eligible people default to Tier 3 when no sparse override row exists.
People under 15 have no Capability state; absence is not Tier 3 and not unknown.
Historical Capability state is anchored at death and does not decline due to Health impairment.
art: Entity and Person A/R/T use a zero-centered -100..100 scale.
Person A/R/T is sparse and requires direct personal evidence; otherwise the entity posture or unknown state applies.
No person may retain more than 15 distinct living personal counterparties across incoming and outgoing directions together.
Reciprocal directions count as one counterparty.
regency: Legal majority is 18; the minor remains legal Head of House.
The acting Head is a temporary player and governance actor, never a succession substitute.
Governance, personal guardianship, economic wardship rights, residence, and support are distinct materialized facets.
Exact support economics remain deferred until after specialized-care fulfillment.
inner_council: Every active domestic landed House has four to eight inner-council members excluding the legal and acting Head.
Office creates eligibility, not automatic membership; absent Person A/R/T is structurally unscored rather than distrust.
The eleven selected people aged 15–17 are non-deliberative apprentices.
Rejected candidates and numerical selection scores are review artifacts, not runtime doctrine.
education: Every named learner aged 7–17 in scope has one locked track, provider, setting, and host/guardian evidence profile.
Anonymous LCU children are outside the named assignment population.
Education and hosting profiles create no contract, payment, custody, residence, or runtime authority.
correspondence: Letters and Learning shapes expression and comprehension but is not a personal-literacy flag.
Personal reading, personal writing, documentary literacy, mediation, confidentiality, formal validity, and delivery are separate facts.
Household, office, institutional, paid, or parish mediation can provide access without personal literacy.
Authoring access never creates a message, delivery, seal, knowledge assertion, or legal validity.
household_residence: Every living named person has one opening Household Status receipt and one active primary Household attachment.
All 897 prior review cases are closed; zero V2 rows remain review-required.
Physical residence and household membership are distinct; duty presence does not silently replace primary residence.
Education hosting may move physical residence for a term without changing household membership.
residence_reconciliation: Immediate former co-residence remains direct Person A/R/T memory at the Turn 0 boundary; no locked score changes.
A new education host creates observation context but no automatic Person A/R/T edge.
Personal literacy remains unchanged; mediation follows the host House or church institution for the term.
No message, delivery, or Knowledge assertion is created.
specialized_care: Ordinary continuing care increases pooled HSU and condition Goods demand; it creates no named provider.
Specialized ongoing care requires a named qualified full-time practitioner; HSU cannot substitute.
The 17 locked Care Commitments are specialized; six use internal qualified practitioners and eleven use external retainers.
Each external appointment is full-time at 1.0 employment PAS even though the named recipient directly draws 0.25 PAS.
Beneficiary PAS is not an employment fraction and creates no fractional remuneration discount.
Each external provider receives 30 Coin, 6 Food, and 3 Goods annually.
Provider package Goods remain distinct from condition-level Health Goods.
Seven external providers are exact-local-LCU and four are bounded nearest-LCU exceptions.
A retained appointment creates duty presence, not a primary household or residence change.

change_control: Any locked-fact change requires founder approval and a new versioned package. Downstream CPO and engineering work must preserve these facts and boundaries. This registry grants no SQLite, schema, runtime, contract, economic, UI, fixture, golden, or legacy-runtime authority.
The immutable opening Household Status receipt remains source evidence; residence changes are appended as later receipts and current state is projected.
Any future primary-residence change must append a receipt with reason, authority, support, and cross-domain dependency evidence.
